method_prenamed: The six statistics below were PRE-NAMED in the measurement script (scratchpad working file measure_kinematics.py) BEFORE any number was computed — no post-hoc statistic selection. All are learning-free (computed on the ground-truth fabric only). Companion (cortex echo) is secondary, learned-side, confounded by learning.

windows.note: Fabric BUILT to T=1,000,008 (h_max=1M; cfg.T=steps+8, the committed verdict build). Kinematics measured over frames [0, 500000) (= read_at, the run/committed-read window). exam_n identity check lands on [0, 499800) = 1666 emitted eval columns x 300.

recipe.identity_crosscheck: Per seed, the full committed fabric manifest (T, n_dwells, cap_hits, realized_mean_k, k_min_realized_frac, truncated_last_dwell, mask_mix{exam,probe_exam,mid_vis,mid_word}, member_hist[16], background_const[4]) must equal the rebuild EXACTLY (byte-level), AND sum(is_exam[0:499800]) must equal the committed sum of per-column exam_n. Any mismatch = STOP.
recipe.stat1_perstep: For frames [0,W): within-dwell |c_t-c_{t-1}| (pos_t>1); cross-boundary (pos_t==1, i.e. last frame of dwell i -> onset of dwell i+1); shuffled-adjacent baseline = adjacent diffs after a fixed random permutation of the W in-window frames (gen seed SEED_SHUFFLE+seed = the committed A-SHUFFLE key) = random neighbor pairs. Per axis (|d|) and L2 norm; median/IQR(q25,q75)/mean. within:shuffled and cross:shuffled reported on median norm.
recipe.stat2_netpath: Per dwell fully contained in [0,W) (onset_idx + k <= W): net = ||c_end - c_onset||, path = sum_{j>=1} ||c_j - c_{j-1}||, ratio = net/path. Bucketed by dwell length p2/p3/p4-6/p7-12/p13-48. p2 == 1.0 by definition (single step).
recipe.stat3_radius: Per contained dwell: radius_norm = max_j ||c_j - c_onset||; per-axis radius = max_j |c_{j,ax}-c_{onset,ax}|. Reported as fraction of per-axis support (width 2*bound=3.0), of box half-diagonal (bound*sqrt(4)=3.0) and full diagonal (6.0). onset_pose_sd_per_axis = spread of the pose SPACE dwells sit in.
recipe.stat4_autocorr: Within-dwell deviation dev_t = c_t - c_onset(dwell of t). For lag L in 1..12, pooled Pearson over axis-flattened (dev_t, dev_{t-L}) pairs with pos_t>L (same dwell). Theory (stationary OU) = (1-theta)^L = 0.75^L. Empirical sits slightly below theory because dev is anchored at 0 at onset (transient-from-onset, not fully stationary) — reported, not corrected.
recipe.stat5_dwelllen: Dwells with onset in [0,W): mean_k, median_k, P(k=2), P(k>=13), cap-hits(k=48), histogram by bucket. Design: k=2+Geom0(0.1), E[k]=11, P(k=2)=0.1, cap-hit theory ~0.71%.
recipe.stat6_designed_vs_realized: Designed OU params pulled from exp12_fabric.py (coeff_std=0.5, theta=1/tau=0.25, tau=4, stationary_frac=0.25, s_step=sigma_step(0.5)=0.0826797, bound=1.5). Realized: per-axis within-step sd, per-axis stationary-deviation sd (mid frames), lag1 autocorr. Theory step_sd/axis = sqrt(theta^2*Var(dev)+s_step^2)=0.08839 where Var(dev)=s_step^2/(1-(1-theta)^2).
recipe.companion_cortex_echo: SECONDARY, learned-side, confounded by learning. Mean over the last 10 eval columns of div_nuis and d2_spread, A_dwell (exp12_dwell) vs C_shuffle (exp12_shuffle) EXP14 verdict records; averaged across seeds 0-7. Rides as context only; never a primary number.
